purpose: Record additional globally diverse anchor candidates reviewed after the prior evidence wave, with explicit promotion/rejection reasons and exact missing evidence. This is an append-only research diagnostic, not a training target table.

method.promotion_threshold: mappable same-boundary aggregate, defensible population interval, independent local-food pressure evidence, resolved shocks/trade/urbanization, and a literature-supported saturation interval
method.result: No candidate in this wave meets all promotion conditions. Rejections are retained so future work has a precise evidence queue rather than silently dropping plausible regions.

why_not_training: broad reconstructed population includes urban/market populations
candidate_summary.next_evidence: A county/comarca-level rural polygon with enumeration or archaeological interval and independent land-scarcity/real-wage pressure evidence.

why_not_training: 1329 point estimate has no uncertainty or saturation interval
Palma/port population is mixed with rural island
candidate_summary.next_evidence: Import-adjusted rural population series and an island-wide or comarca-level pressure/saturation interval; otherwise retain as a negative control.

why_not_training: irrigation institutions are documented but no medieval population interval
distributed subak catchments have no single mapped aggregate boundary
candidate_summary.next_evidence: Dated subak/watershed polygon, 1100-1500 local population or capacity interval, and independent pressure evidence.

why_not_training: tank infrastructure supports physical feasibility only
candidate_summary.next_evidence: Tank-cascade polygon and a dated population/pressure series that separates equilibrium capacity from political abandonment and urban population.
